subject: Marketplace metering dispute & invoice reconciliation for CloudBridge listing
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace metering anomaly — CloudBridge listing fees in April invoice

Hi team,

I pulled the April AWS Marketplace invoice and noticed an unexpected line that looks like CloudBridge listing fees were billed twice: once as a standard listing charge and again under a "co-sell" revenue share. The numbers don't line up with the HubSpot usage report (attached).

Quick facts:
- Invoice: 2027-04-28-AWS-invoice-4572.pdf (attached)
- Affected account: CloudBridge Partners (HubSpot DL-2027-1137)
- Discrepancy: $12,450 billed twice across two codes (see attached CSV)

Ask: can someone confirm whether we (1) passed listing credits through to CloudBridge that were later re-billed, or (2) whether this is an AWS metering/aggregation issue? If the latter, we should open a billing dispute with AWS to get an adjustment and request a corrected invoice.

I've attached the CloudBridge usage export and the HubSpot deal snapshot for context. I've also created a Jira ticket (INC-9982) to track.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Commercial Ops — Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-04-28-AWS-invoice-4572.pdf (pdf), cloudbridge-usage-report-202704.csv (csv), hubspot-deal-DL-2027-1137.pdf (pdf)

-----

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace metering anomaly — CloudBridge listing fees in April invoice

Thanks for flagging this, Camila.

Two quick ideas:
1) If CloudBridge accepted a co-sell credit on their side, that could cause a mirrored line item depending on their billing integration. Can we confirm with Alice at CloudBridge whether they received a credit?
2) If not, escalate to AWS Marketplace billing and ask for the invoice to be put on hold while they investigate — we want to avoid recognizing the double charge in our monthly P&L.

I'm available for a quick call if helpful. I'll draft the dispute text we can send to AWS.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

-----

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
Cc: CloudBridge Partners <alice@cloudbridge.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Dispute request: potential duplicate billing on invoice 4572 (CloudBridge Partners)

Hello AWS Marketplace Billing team,

We're requesting an investigation and correction for invoice #4572 (dated 2027-04-28) for our account. We believe a CloudBridge listing fee was billed twice: once as a listing charge (code LST-001) and once under a "co-sell revenue share" (code RSH-CC).

Details:
- Redwood account: redwood-inference (AWS account ID: 789012345678)
- Affected external partner: CloudBridge Partners (partner id CB-993)
- Invoice: 2027-04-28-AWS-invoice-4572.pdf (attached)
- Supporting usage: cloudbridge-usage-report-202704.csv (attached)
- HubSpot deal: DL-2027-1137 (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/DL-2027-1137)

Requested action:
1) Confirm whether both line items are valid and provide the metering/contractual justification for each.
2) If duplicate billing occurred, issue a corrected invoice and credit for the duplicate amount ($12,450).
3) Provide a short explanation so we can close INC-9982 on our side.

Please advise any additional data you need; happy to provide raw S3 usage exports or partner IDs.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Commercial Ops — Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

-----

From: AWS Marketplace Billing <aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, CloudBridge Partners <alice@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T14:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dispute request: potential duplicate billing on invoice 4572 (CloudBridge Partners)

Hi Camila — thanks for the detail and attachments. We're opening an internal billing investigation (Ref: AWS-BILL-2027-0593).

Preliminary findings: there are two separate meter codes tied to different contract primitives — one for the listing fee (LST-001) and one for a co-sell settlement (RSH-CC). On face value both appear valid, but we need to reconcile the partner-side settlement records to ensure the co-sell entry wasn't already netted at the partner accounting level.

Action items for us:
- AWS will request settlement evidence from CloudBridge for the RSH-CC line.
- If CloudBridge confirms they already netted the credit, AWS will reissue a corrected invoice and post a credit to Redwood.
- We expect an initial update by 2027-05-05; final resolution may take up to 10 business days depending on partner response.

If you can provide a partner invoice or proof that CloudBridge applied/received a credit on their books, please upload to the Jira ticket INC-9982 or reply here.

Regards,
J. Miller
AWS Marketplace Billing Operations
aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com

-----

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudBridge Partners <alice@cloudbridge.com>, AWS Marketplace Billing <aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace metering anomaly — CloudBridge listing fees in April invoice (update)

Quick update for the thread: AWS has opened AWS-BILL-2027-0593 and asked CloudBridge to confirm whether the RSH-CC line was already netted on their side. I pinged Alice this morning for a partner-side settlement file (requested in the HubSpot note) — she said she'll share by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps (short):
- Alice to upload partner settlement evidence to INC-9982 or reply-all with a PDF
- AWS to provide preliminary invoice adjustment guidance by 2027-05-05
- I'll hold accounting from recognizing the $12.45k until either AWS issues a credit or CloudBridge confirms netting

I'll update the ticket and mark any change to P&L. Thanks for the quick triage.

Camila
Commercial Ops — Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: 2027-04-28-AWS-invoice-4572.pdf, cloudbridge-usage-report-202704.csv, hubspot-deal-DL-2027-1137.pdf
